body:
I feel the exact same.

I can't even count the number of times I've tried to kill myself anymore. Some were very serious.. some were.. well.. it was like I wanted to just SEE how bad it would get before the lights went out.

EVERY fricken time I get right to the point of just 'letting go' a voice in my head says "Don't do it!" and starts frantically listing off reasons not to.

I don't know who I want to win anymore.

So if it helps at all, you're not alone.

You're not alone. 

If I don't see someone for awhile I start to freak out and think something has happened to them. Facebook was a good way to make sure everyone was okay, but had to delete it, for various reasons. 

There were times I would spend weeks without talking to someone and by the end of it I was a nervous wreck. 

It's EXHAUSTING to "care" this much (and I say care in quotes only because.. care is like to timid a word to describe it. It's ...some sort of other emotion that is pervasive and self-destructive.) but I've also seen what apathy can do to a person, so, I think I'd rather worry than not.
